notes.title: Wild Roots Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Wild Roots Demo is LIVE on Steam!  

The wait is over, farm-friends and critter wranglers! The Wild Roots demo has officially sprouted on Steam and is ready for you to dig in.  Jump into a vibrant world where peaceful farming collides with crop-powered chaos! Grow your garden, cook homemade meals, and watch your living plants rise up to defend the homestead against waves of mischievous critters.

Whether you're chasing chickens, brewing potato soup, or just vibing to the music in your veggie patch—there’s a little something for every root in the soil. 

What to Expect in the Demo: Plant and harvest, Defend your crops with animated plant guardians  Build, craft, and automate your growing homestead  Discover cozy secrets hidden in the wild  tussle with adorable (and chaotic) critters   

Download now on Steam and let us know what you think—your feedback is fertilizer for our future updates!
